name: dobstudio
description: DobStudio — All-in-One AI Subtitle & Voice Clone Dubbing Desktop Workstation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dobstudio/core && npm run build -w @dobstudio/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dobstudio/core && npm run typecheck -w @dobstudio/app
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @dobstudio/app
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run test:editor
